title: عُمَرُ وَالْأَضْوَاءُ الْخَمْسَةُ تَحْتَ نُجُومِ إِرْبِدَ
summary: يُرَتِّبُ عُمَرُ مَصَابِيحَهُ الصَّغِيرَةَ عَلَى سَطْحِ بَيْتِ جَدَّتِهِ فِي إِرْبِدَ، ثُمَّ يَنْقَطِعُ التَّيَّارُ فَتُصْبِحُ الْأَشْيَاءُ أَقَلَّ وُضُوحًا. يَعُدُّ عَلَى أَصَابِعِهِ مِنْ وَاحِدٍ إِلَى خَمْسَةٍ، وَيُرَاقِبُ النُّجُومَ مَعَ أُخْتِهِ نُورٍ. بِهُدُوءٍ، يَكْتَشِفُ سَبَبَ تَوَقُّفِ مِصْبَاحٍ، ثُمَّ يَرْسُمُ بِالْمَصَابِيحِ مَمَرًّا ذَهَبِيًّا لِلْعَائِلَةِ.
dedication: إِلَى عُمَرَ، الَّذِي يَمْنَحُ قَلْبَهُ خَمْسَ لَحَظَاتٍ هَادِئَةً قَبْلَ كُلِّ خُطْوَةٍ جَدِيدَةٍ.
character_brief: A five-year-old Jordanian boy with a small childlike build, warm olive skin, a round face, large dark-brown eyes, and short tousled wavy dark-brown hair. He always wears a mustard long-sleeve shirt, deep-teal sleeveless vest, cream trousers, and berry-red slippers.
supporting_character_brief: Nour is the child character’s eight-year-old sister, visibly taller and older, with warm olive skin, large dark eyes, and long dark-brown hair in one side braid tied with a berry ribbon. She wears a cream blouse, berry pinafore, and teal cardigan.

visual_continuity.characters: The child character keeps the mustard shirt, deep-teal vest, cream trousers and berry-red slippers on every page. Nour keeps her berry-ribbon side braid, cream blouse, berry pinafore and teal cardigan. Grandmother wears a cream headscarf and a deep-teal Jordanian dress with restrained gold embroidery.
visual_continuity.locations: All action stays at grandmother’s traditional Irbid home: a square rooftop with a waist-high pale-limestone parapet, a cream-plaster stairwell doorway on the east side, a black metal water tank behind it, terracotta herb pots along the south wall, and Irbid’s hilly cityscape beyond.
visual_continuity.objects: Exactly five palm-sized brass-and-cream battery lamps with rounded star-cut shades and berry-red switches begin on one round olive-wood tray. The first lamp’s small brass battery cover is visibly loose on pages 4–6, secured from page 7 onward; all five form one stairway path on pages 8–10.
visual_continuity.timeline: A clear early evening becomes a moonlit power cut on page 2. Pages 2–6 use cool moonlight only; one battery lamp glows warm gold on page 7, all five glow from page 8 onward, and the sky grows richer with visible stars without changing weather or location.

cover.illustration_description: The child character stands calmly on grandmother’s Irbid rooftop beneath a deep-teal starry sky, one hand open to five glowing brass-and-cream lamps arranged beside him while Nour smiles nearby. Pale-limestone parapet and distant hills below; leave the upper 40% calm, dark and uncluttered for the title.

pages.text: عَلَى سَطْحِ بَيْتِ جَدَّتِهِ فِي إِرْبِدَ، رَتَّبَ عُمَرُ خَمْسَةَ مَصَابِيحَ صَغِيرَةٍ، وَعَدَّ أَصَابِعَهُ قَبْلَ أَنْ يَخْتَارَ لِكُلِّ مِصْبَاحٍ مَكَانًا.
pages.illustration_description: Wide early-evening establishing shot on a traditional Irbid rooftop: the child character kneels beside a round olive-wood tray, arranging exactly five palm-sized brass-and-cream battery lamps with berry switches. Pale-limestone parapet, cream stairwell doorway, terracotta herb pots, distant hillside city and first stars; action in upper 70%.

pages.text: فَجْأَةً، انْقَطَعَ التَّيَّارُ، فَخَفَتَتِ الْغُرْفَةُ وَالسَّطْحُ. تَوَقَّفَتْ يَدُ عُمَرَ، وَاقْتَرَبَتْ نُورٌ مِنْهُ، وَبَقِيَتْ جَدَّتُهُ قَرِيبَةً وَمُبْتَسِمَةً عِنْدَ الْبَابِ.
pages.illustration_description: Medium rooftop view just after the household lights go out: the child character pauses with one hand above the olive-wood tray, Nour steps close at his right side, and grandmother watches from the cream stairwell doorway. Cool moonlight, pale-limestone parapet and exactly five unlit lamps; action in upper 70%.

pages.text: رَفَعَ عُمَرُ كَفَّهُ أَمَامَ ضَوْءِ الْقَمَرِ، وَقَالَ لِنُورٍ: «سَأَعُدُّ أَوَّلًا». فَتَحَ إِصْبَعًا، ثُمَّ آخَرَ، حَتَّى وَصَلَ إِلَى خَمْسَةٍ.
pages.illustration_description: Close-up expression shot of the child character lifting one open hand into cool moonlight and slowly extending his fingers, his large dark-brown eyes moving from uncertainty toward focus. Nour’s reassuring face and berry-ribbon braid enter from the side; the five unlit brass-and-cream lamps blur behind them, upper 70%.

pages.text: حَمَلَ مِصْبَاحًا صَغِيرًا وَضَغَطَ زِرَّهُ، لَكِنَّهُ لَمْ يُضِئْ. لَمَحَ عُمَرُ غِطَاءَ الْبَطَّارِيَّةِ مُرْتَخِيًا، فَوَضَعَ الْمِصْبَاحَ بِحَذَرٍ عَلَى الصِّينِيَّةِ.
pages.illustration_description: Important-object close-up on the round olive-wood tray: the child character’s small hands hold the first brass-and-cream battery lamp, its berry-red switch pressed and its little brass battery cover visibly loose. Four matching unlit lamps remain arranged behind it; cool moonlight and faces kept within upper 70%.

pages.text: أَشَارَتْ نُورٌ إِلَى السَّمَاءِ، فَبَدَتِ النُّجُومُ أَوْضَحَ مِنْ قَبْلُ. أَخَذَ عُمَرُ نَفَسًا هَادِئًا مَعَ كُلِّ إِصْبَعٍ، وَعَادَتْ عَيْنَاهُ تَلْتَقِطَانِ التَّفَاصِيلَ.
pages.illustration_description: Low-angle medium shot from the tray: Nour points toward the clearer stars above Irbid while the child character watches his own slowly opening hand and breathes steadily. Their fixed outfits and faces catch cool moonlight; pale-limestone parapet, terracotta herb pots and dark hillside city remain visible, action upper 70%.

pages.text: وَجَدَ عُمَرُ الْبَطَّارِيَّةَ قُرْبَ حَافَّةِ الصِّينِيَّةِ، فَأَعَادَهَا إِلَى مَكَانِهَا بِحَذَرٍ. ثَبَّتَ الْغِطَاءَ، وَطَلَبَ مِنْ نُورٍ أَنْ تَحْمِلَ بَقِيَّةَ الْمَصَابِيحِ.
pages.illustration_description: Over-the-shoulder action view: the child character carefully returns a small brass battery to the first lamp on the olive-wood tray and secures its loose brass cover. Nour gathers the other four matching lamps beside him; cream stairwell doorway and grandmother remain nearby, all under cool moonlight in upper 70%.

pages.text: أَضَاءَ الْمِصْبَاحُ الْأَوَّلُ بِلَوْنٍ ذَهَبِيٍّ دَافِئٍ. ابْتَسَمَ عُمَرُ، ثُمَّ جَرَّبَ الْمَصَابِيحَ وَاحِدًا بَعْدَ وَاحِدٍ، بَيْنَمَا ظَلَّتْ نُورٌ إِلَى جَانِبِهِ.
pages.illustration_description: Medium action shot as the repaired first brass-and-cream lamp glows warm gold on the olive-wood tray, its brass cover now secure. The child character smiles and reaches toward the next lamp while Nour stays beside him holding two more; cool moonlight and golden light mix across their outfits, upper 70%.

pages.text: عَدَّ عُمَرُ مَرَّةً أُخْرَى: وَاحِدٌ، اثْنَانِ، ثَلَاثَةٌ، أَرْبَعَةٌ، خَمْسَةٌ. مَعَ كُلِّ عَدَدٍ، وَضَعَ مِصْبَاحًا عَلَى دَرَجَةٍ، فَصَنَعَ مَمَرًّا مُنِيرًا إِلَى السَّطْحِ.
pages.illustration_description: High diagonal view of the rooftop stairs: the child character places the fifth glowing brass-and-cream lamp on a step, completing one orderly path of exactly five warm lights from the cream doorway to the rooftop. Nour steadies the empty olive-wood tray; grandmother waits safely nearby, action and faces upper 70%.

pages.text: صَعِدَتْ جَدَّتُهُ مَعَ الْعَائِلَةِ فِي ضَوْءِ الْمَمَرِّ الصَّغِيرِ. جَلَسُوا قُرْبَ السُّورِ، وَصَارَتْ مَصَابِيحُ عُمَرَ تُشْبِهُ نُجُومًا قَرِيبَةً تَحْرُسُ سَهْرَتَهُمْ.
pages.illustration_description: Wide rooftop release: grandmother and the family arrive together along the path of exactly five glowing brass-and-cream lamps, then gather by the pale-limestone parapet. The child character and Nour sit together beneath a richer star field, warm gold light on faces, terracotta herb pots and Irbid hills behind, upper 70%.

pages.text: مَدَّ عُمَرُ كَفَّهُ فَوْقَ الْمَصَابِيحِ الْخَمْسَةِ، وَنُورٌ تُلَامِسُ كَفَّهُ بِكَفِّهَا. فَوْقَهُمَا، لَمَعَتْ نُجُومُ إِرْبِدَ، وَتَابَعَ عُمَرُ عَدَّهُ بِابْتِسَامَةٍ هَادِئَةٍ.
pages.illustration_description: Quiet intimate close-up: the child character holds his open hand above the line of exactly five glowing brass-and-cream lamps while Nour gently touches her palm to his. Their fixed clothes and warm faces fill the upper frame; Irbid’s stars shine above the pale-limestone parapet, calm golden light, upper 70%.
